context_for_next_testing_agent: GymAxis Memberships Phase 1a fully tested. Key findings: (1) Plan CRUD works - POST creates plan with all fields, PATCH updates allowed fields, DELETE soft-archives and removes from GET /plans list, (2) Class Template CRUD works - POST creates template and materialises 8 weeks of occurrences, PATCH updates, DELETE archives and cancels future occurrences, (3) Email hooks wired correctly - booking confirmation, waitlist promotion, class cancellation all dispatch via BackgroundTasks. Emails fail at Resend API level (domain not verified) but code is correct, (4) Waitlist promotion flow verified - when booked member cancels, waitlisted member is promoted with promoted_from_waitlist_at timestamp set, (5) Frontend has all 5 tabs (Dashboard, Members, Timetable, Classes, Plans), (6) Plan Editor Modal has all fields: name, kind, billing_cycle, price, upfront_fee, included_classes, credits, duration, freeze_allowed, freeze_max_days, cancel_notice_days, description, colour, (7) Class Editor Modal has all 7 day chips (Mon-Sun) and fields: name, category, colour, instructor, room, start_time, duration, capacity, booking_opens, cancel_cutoff, credits_to_book, waitlist_enabled, max_waitlist, (8) Edit/Archive buttons visible on plan cards (4 each for 4 seeded plans)
